verdict.rationale: Asana's developer docs mention 'app components' that let third-party apps plug into the UI on the surface of tasks or rules, which is the closest analog to embedding native-feeling widgets, but there's no evidence of a dedicated dashboard-widget or custom-view builder SDK for designers specifically. Missing for 10: documented dashboard/widget builder APIs, custom view creation tools, and any hands-on/independent confirmation that these app components render as native Asana views or dashboards.
